Command.Comment: ecaz Task 107 phase1 rabitq 1m l1 resume suite

commands: PG_BIN=/usr/pgsql-18/bin; if [ ! -x "$PG_BIN/psql" ]; then PG_BIN=$(dirname "$(command -v psql)"); fi

upload_artifacts() { status=$1; echo step=upload-artifacts status=$status; for f in df-resume-before.log df-resume-after.log index-validity.log load.log inspect.log run-suite-resume.log cleanup-drop.log residue-after-cleanup.log; do if [ -f "$NODE_DIR/$f" ]; then aws s3 cp "$NODE_DIR/$f" "s3://$BUCKET/$S3_PREFIX/load/$f" --region us-west-2 || true; fi; done; if [ -d "$BENCH_DIR" ]; then aws s3 cp "$BENCH_DIR" "s3://$BUCKET/$S3_PREFIX/bench" --recursive --region us-west-2 || true; fi; }

"$PG_BIN/psql" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -At -c "SELECT 'row_count', count(*) FROM task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l1_corpus; SELECT 'query_count', count(*) FROM task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l1_queries; SELECT 'index_state', c.relname, i.indisready, i.indisvalid, i.indislive, am.amname, pg_relation_size(c.oid), c.reloptions FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid = c.oid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = c.relam WHERE c.relname = 'task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l1_idx';" > "$NODE_DIR/index-validity.log"

"$PG_BIN/psql" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -c "DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l1_idx; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l1_queries CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l1_corpus CASCADE;" > "$NODE_DIR/cleanup-drop.log" 2>&1

"$PG_BIN/psql" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -At -c "SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE relname LIKE 'task107_phase1_rabitq_1m_l1%' ORDER BY relname;" > "$NODE_DIR/residue-after-cleanup.log"
